storage_janitor.title: Storage janitor
storage_janitor.description: Remove stale runtime and temporary artifacts after safe verification.

baseline_health_scan.title: Baseline health scan
baseline_health_scan.description: Run the baseline health and maintenance readiness scan.

tenant_drift_watch.title: Tenant drift watch
tenant_drift_watch.description: Observe tenant drift and surface drift signals.

dependency_vuln_scan.title: Dependency vulnerability scan
dependency_vuln_scan.description: Scan dependency vulnerabilities and append to the ledger.

auto_checkpoint.title: Automatic checkpoint
auto_checkpoint.description: Persist a durable checkpoint for long-running maintenance.

daemon_restart.title: Daemon restart
daemon_restart.description: Restart an unhealthy long-lived daemon (scheduler, supervisor) detected by the heartbeat watchdog. Scored to land on 'approve': the restart runs a platform service-manager command outside the repo sandbox, and a scheduler restarted mid-firing can duplicate or drop work, so it is not an unattended action.

ci_autofix_attempt.title: CI auto-fix attempt
ci_autofix_attempt.description: Classify a failing PR check and push a fix on the PR branch. If the fix deletes, skips, or changes test assertions, rebaselines snapshots, or touches config or baselines, it moves to approve.

pr_merge_low.title: Merge low-risk PR
pr_merge_low.description: Gate-classified as tests, docs, or internal refactor outside high_risk_paths, with no external effect (no publish, daemon, or data migration). CI green and an independent cross-provider review of the head commit.

pr_merge_medium.title: Merge medium-risk PR
pr_merge_medium.description: Behavior changes outside high_risk_paths; same evidence as low, plus a decision card with a fail-closed veto window.

pr_merge_high.title: Merge high-risk PR
pr_merge_high.description: Touches high_risk_paths, any never_auto class, or the author's self-repair cap was reached.

auto_revert_on_main_failure.title: Auto-revert after main breaks
auto_revert_on_main_failure.description: After an autonomous merge, if the main CI failure reproduces on a rerun, open and merge one revert PR per incident and lower the project's autonomy level by one. A conflicting revert escalates to approve.

main_sync_clean.title: Sync main into a branch (clean)
main_sync_clean.description: git merge-tree reports no conflict and tests pass after the sync. The census found 20 of 22 syncs clean; a clean replay is not semantic correctness, so tests stay mandatory.

conflict_mechanical.title: Resolve mechanical conflict
conflict_mechanical.description: Lockfiles, generated files, import ordering: regenerate and re-run tests. pnpm-lock.yaml changes that alter resolved versions are high risk.

conflict_semantic.title: Resolve semantic conflict
conflict_semantic.description: A resolver agent merges both PRs' intents; tests and an independent cross-provider review verify it.

mission_start_mandate.title: Start mission within a standing mandate
mission_start_mandate.description: A standing mandate lists permitted work types, paths, spend, and external effects, and has an expiry. Work outside any of those is not covered.

mission_start_medium.title: Start mission outside mandates
mission_start_medium.description: New work within an existing goal; planner + devil's advocate + reviewer produce one decision card.

mission_start_high.title: Start mission with a new goal or external effect
mission_start_high.description: New goal, external publication, customer-facing effect, or over budget.

stale_wait_escalation.title: Escalate stale waits
stale_wait_escalation.description: Missions planned or paused, and approvals pending, beyond a threshold are listed in the digest with a proposed action (resume, cancel, archive). The census found 23 silent mission waits, the oldest from 2026-07-26.

secret_mutation.title: Introduce or change a secret
secret_mutation.description: never_auto: always a human decision with a second factor, regardless of scores.
